_meta.what: Per-line product categories, for suspended NHS Supply Chain lines whose eClass code was too broad to map safely.
_meta.why: A whole-eClass refusal is coarse. FRP for example is mostly NeuWave microwave TUMOUR ablation but also carries cardiac EP RF-ablation catheters, so the code could not be mapped without risking a tumour probe being offered as an alternative to a cardiac catheter. Deciding line by line keeps the unambiguous ones and still refuses the rest.
_meta.rule: One line, one decision, taken from that line's own NHS Supply Chain description. Every category is validated against the gated vocabulary in differentiator-category-map.json. A line whose description does not clearly belong to one category is REFUSED and listed below, never forced into the nearest bucket — publishing nothing is the correct output when the evidence is thin.
_meta.precedence: These win over data/eclass-category-map.json for the NPCs named here, because they are the more specific judgement.
